name: tft096_st7735
title: 0.96-inch TFT on an ST7735S
description: An 80x160 IPS colour display on SPI, eight contacts in a row: the backlight on a line of its own, BLK
notes: NFP096H-01AY on the ribbon of the panel. Q1 with R1 to R3 on the back switches the backlight: R3 holds it on while BLK is open, low on BLK turns it off.
The controller is set for 128x160 and the glass lies at column 24 of it, with its colours in BGR order.

front.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

back.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened and turned

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13
photo.notes: GND VCC SCL SDA RES DC CS BLK beside the pins on the front, from the bottom; J1 on the back, with 4-SPI, IC:ST7735S, Display Color:65K. R1 is marked 100, R2 102, R3 103; Q1, C1, and no regulator.

schematic.source: QDtech, 0.96inch IPS of 2019-07-27, the schematic of lcdwiki for its MSP0961 (https://www.lcdwiki.com/res/MSP0961/0.96inch_IPS_Schematic.pdf, sha256 e5e0df51...), for a board with the same parts and contacts: J1 GND VCC3.3 SCL SDA RESET RS CS BL; VCC3.3 straight to VCC and LEDA of the panel; BL through R2 1K to the base of Q1, an S8050, R3 10K from the base to VCC3.3, R1 10R in LEDK

glass.source: the page of the MSP0961 of lcdwiki (www.lcdwiki.com/0.96inch_IPS_Module): active area 10.80x21.70 mm. Not measured on this one.

trial.source: ~/dgx-bench/st7735-80x160-2026-11-13, built with ESP-IDF 5.5.4 against the working copy of DGX before 0.11.0 was released, on SPI3 of an ESP32 at 10 MHz: SCK 18, MOSI 23, CS 5, DC 17, RST 16, BLK 4; ST7735_RESOLUTION_80x160, 16 bits in BGR. The CHANGES of DGX 0.11.0 say it was seen right in all eight orientations, the backlight turned off and on by dgx_st7735_backlight().

start.source: What the ST7735 driver starts with for ST7735_RESOLUTION_80x160; which edge of the module was up in the trial is not written down.
